_description: Edge-device attestation benchmark for the per-microgrid circuit (CircuitMGv2, T=24, BN254/Groth16) on a Raspberry Pi 4B gateway. Values are the medians of five runs. The harness that produced them ships as zkp_circuit/bench_pi_test.go (TestBenchPi); rerunning it as 'PI_BENCH=1 BENCH_PI_OUT=<path> ./benchv2_pi_inst -test.run TestBenchPi -test.v' regenerates this file, including per-run minima, maxima, and IQR bounds, which this record does not carry because the paper does not quote them.

provenance.circuit: per-microgrid CircuitMGv2, T=24, statement carrying the directed trade row (588 public-input field elements)
provenance.note: Rerun after the 2026-09-18 statement revision (net import -> directed trade row). The prove/verify/peak-RSS medians below are from the author's Pi run reported into this record; the device_state block is carried over from the 2026-09-15 run and was not re-captured for the rerun. Drop in the harness-written JSON (pi_bench.json) to replace the whole record with per-run bounds and a fresh device_state.

device_state.throttled_interpretation: carried over from the 2026-09-15 run (no throttling then; the timings are not thermally floor-limited). Not re-captured for the 2026-09-18 rerun.

units: prove_ms_median and verify_ms_median are milliseconds; peak_rss_MB is the peak resident set (VmHWM) over the per-microgrid configuration; prove_plus_verify_s is the end-to-end attestation per dispatch; prove_cpu_pct_one_core is percent of ONE core, so 400 means all four cores saturated (carried over, not re-captured).
